meta.name: MERA Open Humanoid Robot Database
meta.description: Specifications and status of humanoid robot models from manufacturers worldwide. A description of the market, not MERA stock. No prices.
meta.attribution_note: When you use the data, credit "MERA Robotics, merarobotics.com" and link to https://merarobotics.com/blog/humanoids (CC BY 4.0).

fields.id: Stable slug, also the last segment of the model page address
fields.name: Display name (manufacturer and model)
fields.model: Model name as used by the manufacturer
fields.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the manufacturer country; null when not established
fields.country_name: Country name in English; null when not established
fields.status: One of: shipping, preorder, research, in-development, unconfirmed, obsolete
fields.release_year: Year of the first public presentation or launch; null when not established
fields.height_cm: Height in centimetres; null when the manufacturer does not publish it
fields.weight_kg: Mass in kilograms; null when not published
fields.payload_kg: Payload in kilograms as stated by the manufacturer; null when not published
fields.dof: Degrees of freedom as stated by the manufacturer (configurations differ); null when not published
fields.speed_ms: Maximum walking or running speed in metres per second; null when not published
fields.runtime_h: Battery runtime in hours as stated by the manufacturer; null when not published
fields.source: Page the specifications were taken from
fields.verified: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last review of the model entry by MERA Robotics; null when the model has no reviewed entry yet
fields.pages: Object: language code to the address of the model page on merarobotics.com, only for languages where the page exists (PL and EN for every model)
